pendulum_as_source.note: Copied from supplied firmware comments; measure current assembly including hub. Do not reuse old 100 mm geometry silently.

notes: Rail travel MUST be measured in guided homing, not taken from an old default.
Z pulse outputs remain LOW; shared ENABLE energizes/disables all three drivers. Secure vertical axes.
No encoder EEPROM writes, no swing-up/balance, no limit-switch inputs, no Ethernet transport in this build.
